status: Generic candidates only; parent proposal and official skills not edited
scope: 052 observed behaviors and logical/pure contract, not task-specific target/ID hints

candidates.topic: Verify exact duplicates before destructive action
candidates.suggestion: Use repeated titles/descriptions only to select candidates. Associate records with their own card/detail and compare sufficient complete business fields; any observed field difference disqualifies exact equality.
candidates.evidence: Pan and Avocado original logical candidates differ in servings, ingredients, directions and/or time/description despite repeated names.

candidates.topic: Keep record identity and coverage explicit
candidates.suggestion: Do not zip independently queried title/description arrays when lengths or membership differ. Bind fields within each record container and distinguish visible candidates from complete task coverage.
candidates.evidence: Original exec21 and25 title/description lengths differ; late Butternut detail checks cover only four visible variants.

candidates.suggestion: A cell failing after a confirmation action is not transactional rollback. Inspect resulting state before any new destructive action and do not replay solely because a later observation failed.
candidates.evidence: Original exec15 clicks delete confirmation before line3 observation throws.

candidates.suggestion: Treat explicit policy refusal as a constraint; use only permitted bounded interactions, not an equivalent batch/search bypass or an expanded retry budget.
candidates.evidence: Original exec17 UiScrollable scrolling search is explicitly rejected by Harness policy.

candidates.suggestion: Once actual observations establish mistaken deletion or unreliable record identity, stop further destructive changes. Restore only through an identified authorized normal recovery path and verify it; otherwise report partial/failed and unknown effects honestly.
candidates.evidence: Original final honestly acknowledges failed preservation; an Undo lookup returns empty and does not prove successful recovery.
candidates.limit: This is a future generic rule, not evidence that the original model subjectively knew of the mistake before exec24.

candidates.topic: Keep outcome and evidence equally honest
candidates.suggestion: Retain a truthful failed outcome; do not promote unverified same-name records to true duplicates in the supporting narrative or claim persistent per-ID deletion without supporting data.
candidates.evidence: Original final says failed but still labels Pan/Avocado as duplicate, inconsistent with the exact frozen fields.

notProposed: Task-specific Butternut reference hints or synthetic IDs sent to Agent
Automatic database restoration, retries or noise-deletion exemptions
New live run or a promise of score improvement
